Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler is unavailable: the automations tool returned a credentials error, and the OpenClaw setup call failed because the AI service sign-in has expired. Nothing is scheduled yet, so no digest will post on Monday 19 October until this is fixed. Someone with Gateway access needs to sign in under Models or run `openclaw configure`, and then I can create the job. I can also post the first digest by hand if you'd like one sooner.

Two notes on what the digest will include:
- It will skip finance figures such as rates, discounts and contract values, and any finance documents. The discount figures in the Nov 2025 messages are an example, so I won't repeat them here.
- Both channels have the same four members, so posting the combined digest in #coastal-team doesn't widen who can see anything.
